newsitem.title: USA: McMoRan has Vermilion Block natgas find.
newsitem.headline: McMoRan has Vermilion Block natgas find.

text.p: McMoRan Oil & Gas Co said Tuesday it has discovered new natural gas reserves while drilling on its Vermilion Block 160 Field Unit.

Eight gas sands have been logged in the Vermilion Block 159 AJ-3 discovery well totaling some 215 feet of net pay at depths ranging from 13,500 feet to 15,500 feet. Seven of the sands represent new reserves to the field, McMoRan said.
Casing is being set and the well will continue drilling deeper through additional objectives until it reaches a total depth of about 16,600 feet.
The discovery well is being drilled from the Vermilion Block 160 production platform to a bottom hole location on Vermilion Block 159 to the east and "updip" to the known reserves, McMoRan explained.
The field is located in 90 feet of water in the offshore Gulf of Mexico 155 miles west southwest of New Orleans.

The Vermilion 160 Field Unit is comprised of portions of four leases (Vermilion Blocks 143, 144, 159 & 160) totaling 5,625 acres. In addition, the MOXY/MCN program and its partners own interests in or exploration rights to an additional 9,375 acres in the four block area.
Current production from the Vermilion Block 160 Field Unit is about 15 million cubic feet of natural gas and 800 barrels of condensate per day.

The MOXY/MCN program plans further drilling to develop the newly discovered reserves and to explore the area, particularly on Vermilion Block 160 and the farmin acreage on Vermilion Block 159, McMoRan said.

The company is the operator of the Vermilion 160 Field Unit where the MOXY/MCN program currently owns a 40-percent working interest and has an about 28-percent net revenue interest. MOXY has a 40-percent interest in the MOXY/MCN program, a venture with MCN Corp.
Other working interest partners in the Vermilion Block 160 Field Unit include Louisiana Land and Exploration Co, 25 percent; Continental Land & Fur Co Inc, 15 percent; and others, 20 percent.

In Vermilion Block 160 outside of the unit, the MOXY/MCN program owns a 53.3-percent working interest and an about 42.5 percent net revenue interest. The MOXY/MCN program's interest in Vermilion Blocks 160 and 143, including the portion of its interest in the unit resulting from these two blocks, is subject to a 30-percent net profits interest.
